descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S24 Important Points one by one: an old point is not kept alive by a newer point or a Save Note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Hospital Important Points clear at 12 h: an Important Point seeded at 13 h is deleted. (UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: Important Points 12 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). … (UAT OAT-04 Expected 2; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it. (UAT OAT-04 Expected 1; TFA-94699 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital chart H1: point A 'QA point A' written at T0, chart Save-Noted at T0+11 h, point B 'QA point B' added at T0+12 h, probed at T0+13 h. Chart H2: point C 'QA point C' written at T0, the chart Save-Noted every 10 h since, point D 'QA point D' added at T0+32 h, probed at T0+37 h (last Save Note at T0+30 h)

When The purge runs at each probe; raw importantPoints read with admin access

Then H1: A gone, B kept. H2: C gone, D kept

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): H1 from TC-12 ('Points expire 12 h after they were written') and 3.6 (12 h): A present at 13 h = Fail; re-judged if Q3 says the clock is the list's last edit or the chart's last Save Note. H2 from the 3.7 retention claim (U11): C present at 37 h = Fail under any Q3 answer. A kept point (B, D) missing = Fail (too early)

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Evidence: allure 12bacb92-…-result.json; retention lane, real UI with 4 live Save Notes. 2 checks pass, 2 fail, known K1 (one ptsEditedAt clock for the whole list, maxed with notesProcessedAt).
